text: Pellet, gomɗimɓe ɓen tigiri, ko ɓen ɓe tawata si Alla Seniiɗo On jantaama fii mun, ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen hulay ; ɗe fewtida e ɓalli maɓɓe ɗin faade e ɗoftaare. Si tawii kadi Aayeeje Alla ɗen janngaama e maɓɓe, ɓe taskoo ɗe ɓe ɓeydoo gomɗinal. Ko e Joomi maɓɓe tun kadi woni ko ɓe fawotoo fii nafooreeji maɓɓe e duñogol bone e maɓɓe.
